summary: Braskem filed a 6-K on November 12, 2026, responding to a CVM request for clarification (Official Letter 296/2026) on press reports of failed talks with creditors over an extrajudicial reorganization. Reports indicate bondholders rejected a proposal converting US$3.8 billion of debt into equity, and shareholders withdrew a capital injection commitment. The extrajudicial negotiation deadline lapsed November 6 after three extensions, with a judicial deadline November 22, raising risk of a judicial reorganization (the Brazilian analogue of a Chapter 11 filing). Watch the November 22 deadline and any conversion terms.
